part: R55 (Task 26, lane B): the load of the home page, the commit before part R55 against the head
note: Pictures: none. Timed runs held the shared gate lock; the machine was shared with lane A (Task 28 builds and tests; the lock serialises timed runs, so no two timed runs overlapped, but lane A worked between them). Base and head were run alternately, run for run, on the same Chrome and profile settings, each run from a fresh profile with the cache off.

base.commit: 6f98c1c (the commit before part R55), production build in a scratch worktree, served on :5182

head.commit: R55.3d (eabbcae) plus the Task 26 measure.json fix, production build, served on :5181; app code is that of R55.3b (67da026)

command: BASE=http://localhost:<5182|5181> node scripts/audit/cdp.mjs scripts/audit/load-metrics.json <outdir>  (three runs each side, alternating); same for scripts/audit/measure.json

profiles.slow-4g-cpu4-phone /: 390x844, dpr 2, touch, slow 4G (1638 kbit/s, 150 ms), CPU 4x slower, cache off, 20 s after the load
profiles.fast-cable-cpu4-desktop /: 1440x900, dpr 2, 12 Mbit/s and 40 ms, CPU 4x slower, cache off, 20 s after the load

loadMetrics.reading: First paint and the page itself do not move: first contentful paint 632 to 640 ms on the phone and 232 to 256 ms (base) against 212 to 248 ms (head) on the desktop; DOM content loaded the same within 10 ms; layout shift about 0. Requests are equal on the phone (60) and two fewer on the desktop (172 against 174; the head mounts no flat preview for a live box, the cause of the two was not traced). Transfer varies from run to run on both sides by the random painting the hero shows (the hero picks one of several 100 to 750 KB paintings): base 1194 to 1470 KB, head 1144 to 1294 KB on the phone; base 8611 to 9450 KB, head 9073 to 9484 KB on the desktop, so the sides overlap. The phone LCP is the hero painting on a slow network (6.4 to 6.7 s on both sides, median 6600 base, 6528 head): the live boxes add none to it.

measureJson.what: frame gaps of the page interactions at 1440x900 and 390x844 (no CPU slowdown): hero idle incl. a painting change, a card open and close, scroll to the blocks, open the shelf and watching layers, hover, open a book and a video, close
measureJson.fixedInThisTask: At 390x844 the watching layer was opened by clicking the second block's button while the block was far below the screen (a visitor cannot do that: the box scenes are prepared when their block comes within 240 px of the screen, R55.2). The wall then gave up to its plain grid and the next step (hover across the wall canvas) read nothing. The step now scrolls the watching block into view and waits 1.5 s, as a visitor would; the same file runs on the base.
measureJson.firstTryWithTheOlderFile: head, three runs: runs 1 and 3 clean; run 2 had frames of 300 ms (1440, scroll to the blocks), 150 ms (1440, open the reading layer) and 100 ms (390, close reading and open watching), the only frames over 20 ms in 6 runs of that file; base 0 of 3. Not reproduced in the 3 runs of the corrected file; the machine was shared at the time. Recorded here, not explained.
measureJson.reading: With the corrected file: 24 steps per run, no frame over 20 ms, worst gap 16.8 ms, on both sides in all three runs.
